x, y, n = map(int, input().split())
min_difference = 1e15
best_numerator = 0
best_denominator = 1

for denominator in range(1, n + 1):
    numerator = (x * denominator) // y

    def evaluate(candidate):
        nonlocal min_difference, best_numerator, best_denominator
        diff = abs(x * denominator - candidate * y) / (y * denominator)
        if diff < min_difference:
            min_difference = diff
            best_numerator = candidate
            best_denominator = denominator

    if numerator > 0 and (x * denominator - (numerator - 1) * y) == 0:
        print(f"{numerator - 1}/{denominator}")
        exit()
    if (x * denominator - numerator * y) == 0:
        print(f"{numerator}/{denominator}")
        exit()
    if (x * denominator - (numerator + 1) * y) == 0:
        print(f"{numerator + 1}/{denominator}")
        exit()

    evaluate(numerator - 1)
    evaluate(numerator)
    evaluate(numerator + 1)

print(f"{best_numerator}/{best_denominator}")
</translated_code>
